## UI polish: DraftBar 13 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy, Layout and States. Text and brand hue kept. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: The wrapper's `gap-[10px]` is off the scale. It sits halfway between 8 and 12, so it rounds up to `gap-3` (12 px). (R-ui-polish-1) 2. **Spacing**: The wrapper's `p-[13px]` is off the scale. Now `p-3` (12 px). (R-ui-polish-1) 3. **Spacing**: "Save draft" has `px-[7px]`, which is off the scale. Now `px-2` (8 px). (R-ui-polish-1) 4. **Spacing**: "Save draft" has `py-[3px]`, which is off the scale. Now `py-1` (4 px). (R-ui-polish-1) 5. **Spacing**: "Discard" has the same `px-[7px] py-[3px]`. Now `px-2 py-1` (8 px / 4 px). (R-ui-polish-1) 6. **Typography**: The label's `text-[15px]` is off the scale and below the 16 px minimum for body text. Now `text-base` (16 px, line-height 1.5). (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3) 7. **Contrast**: The label's `text-gray-400` (#9ca3af) on white is 2.54:1. Now `text-gray-500` (#6b7280), 4.83:1. (R-ui-polish-4) 8. **Hierarchy**: Both buttons were filled `bg-blue-600`, so the bar had two primary actions. "Save draft" stays filled. "Discard" is now an outline button in the same blue: `bg-white text-blue-600 border border-blue-600`, 5.17:1. (R-ui-polish-5) 9. **Layout**: The buttons were about 30 px tall. Both now have `min-h-11 min-w-11` (44 × 44 px). (R-ui-polish-7) 10. **Layout**: The taller buttons would leave the label sitting at the top of the bar. Added `items-center` to the wrapper. (R-ui-polish-7) 11. **States**: "Save draft" had no hover style. Now `hover:bg-blue-700` (#1d4ed8), and white text on it is 6.70:1. "Discard" had none either. Now `hover:text-blue-700 hover:border-blue-700`, 6.70:1. (R-ui-polish-6) 12. **States**: Neither button had a focus style. Both now have `focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-600`. (R-ui-polish-6) 13. **States**: Neither button had a disabled style. Both now have `disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | "Unsaved draft" label | #9ca3af on #ffffff, 2.54:1 | #6b7280 on #ffffff, 4.83:1 | | "Save draft" button | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 (hover #1d4ed8, 6.70:1) | | "Discard" button | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | #2563eb on #ffffff, 5.17:1 (hover #1d4ed8, 6.70:1) | ### Polished code ```jsx export function DraftBar({ onSave, onDiscard }) { return (
Unsaved draft
); } ``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word: "Unsaved draft", "Save draft", "Discard". - The component name, props and handlers (`DraftBar`, `onSave`, `onDiscard`), and the order of the elements. - Brand hue kept: blue-600 (#2563eb). Hover uses blue-700 (#1d4ed8), a darker shade of the same blue. - One font weight (400). No transitions were added, so no reduced-motion block is needed. ### Open questions - I took "Save draft" as the primary action because it is the first button and the positive action. Tell me if "Discard" should lead instead.
